title: USB HID: Update to match HID Usage Tables version 1.22
description:
Add camera control page (0x90). Usages are up to date with HID Usage
Tables for USB version 1.22.


(cherry picked from commit 64a76cca7f5245a21df2d64cff67839f4a3aa5e9)

notes.body:
added 9 commits
  • 51898099...30fe0c75 - 8 commits from branch release-3.4

[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/4380/diffs?diff_id=255111933&start_sha=51898099171c48b9776e175cf29adf6aea146b99)
